title: ai_governance_procurement_gate
claim: Autonomous AI marketing systems fail in heavy industry because procurement teams audit compliance before they ever read creative copy.
hook: AI generated copy fails every procurement audit.

evidence.detail: Observed enterprise procurement reviews for industrial engineering suppliers where generative copy without traceable sourcing was rejected for non-compliance with ISO standards.

reel_script.onscreen: AI generated copy fails every procurement audit.
reel_script.voiceover: AI generated copy fails every procurement audit. Not because it sounds robotic, but because enterprise buyers require verifiable proof.
reel_script.direction: Close up on a printed procurement specification sheet marked with red review stamps.

reel_script.voiceover: Speed is what generative tools sell. Liability is what large industrial buyers actually buy against.
reel_script.direction: Pan across a stack of heavy industrial equipment compliance manuals.

reel_script.voiceover: When your marketing team uses AI to write product capability claims, you introduce unmonitored risk into an eighteen-month sales cycle.
reel_script.direction: Medium shot of an office workspace with enterprise software dashboards visible.

reel_script.voiceover: Before you let algorithms write another product spec, run this three-point governance check across your output.
reel_script.direction: Cut to a clean checklist graphic against a neutral industrial background.

reel_script.voiceover: First, can you trace every claim to a regulated standard? Second, is the data source publicly verifiable? Third, will legal indemnify the prompt output?
reel_script.direction: Detailed checklist view highlighting the verification steps one by one.

items.label: Trace claims
items.detail: Tie every statement to an ISO standard

reel_script.voiceover: Effective AI governance in marketing is not about creative output quality. It is about whether your buyers can defend your claims to their board.
reel_script.direction: Return to presenter looking directly at the camera.

caption:
AI generated copy fails every procurement audit.

Effective AI governance matters most when selling industrial commodities where every technical assertion must survive a legal review board before an invoice gets signed.

Consumer marketing rewards speed and volume. Enterprise procurement rewards verifiable consistency.

Send this to whoever is defending your marketing technology stack against compliance reviews this quarter.
